en: Portable bundle RhinE-1.3.0-portable.zip: unzip, double-click Setup 一键安装.cmd, done.

One-click install into your own foobar2000: double-click install.cmd. It finds foobar2000, offers to close it, and installs Columns UI and JSplitter when they are missing. uninstall.cmd works the same way.
DSP in the bottom bar: pick a DSP preset, open the equalizer or the DSP Manager.
PREFERENCES in the header opens foobar2000's Preferences.
VISUALIZATIONS in the Signal view opens foobar2000's visualizations and those of installed components.
+ ADD MUSIC FOLDER in the empty Archive.

One-click updates from now on: an UPDATE chip in the bottom bar when a new version is out; it downloads only what changed (GitHub, else jsDelivr), checks it and restarts foobar2000 with your settings.
Installation guides are now separate and short: INSTALL.md / 安装指南.md. Everything else is in README.md / 其他信息.md.
Light / dark now also switches in translated (e.g. Chinese) builds of foobar2000; if it still cannot, a message says where to switch it.

Translated lyrics: many more lines get their translation. NetEase often splits, joins or words lines differently from LRCLIB; lines are now matched by how alike they are, in order (Believer: 44 of 45 lines instead of 37).
zh: 便携懒人包：解压后双击 Setup 一键安装.cmd 即可。
一键安装到你自己的 foobar2000：双击 install.cmd。它会自动找到 foobar2000、询问是否关闭它，缺少 Columns UI 或 JSplitter 时自动安装；卸载同样只需双击 uninstall.cmd。
底栏新增 DSP：切换 DSP 预设，打开均衡器或 DSP 管理器。
顶栏新增 首选项，直接打开 foobar2000 首选项。
信号视图新增 可视化：打开 foobar2000 自带及已安装组件提供的可视化。
档案为空时显示 + 添加音乐文件夹。
从此可以一键更新：有新版本时底栏显示 更新 标签，只下载有变化的文件（GitHub，失败时 jsDelivr），校验后重启 foobar2000，设置保留。
安装说明独立成篇：INSTALL.md / 安装指南.md；其余内容在 README.md / 其他信息.md。
浅色 / 深色切换在汉化版 foobar2000 中也能生效；仍无法切换时会提示在哪里设置。
歌词翻译：更多歌词行能显示译文。网易云的歌词常与 LRCLIB 分行或用词不同，现在按相似度依次匹配（Believer：45 行中 44 行有译文，原来是 37 行）。
